t: Building Construction Site (Residential / Commercial / Industrial Sheds)
desc: Multi-storey and PEB construction in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu: from excavation to handover, including public-interface duties.
hazards: Falls from height, scaffold collapse, excavation collapse, struck-by plant/cranes, electrocution (temporary power/overhead lines), falling objects on public, heat, monsoon flooding
statutory: Registration under OSH Code s.3 (legacy BOCW), cess 1%, worker registration with Welfare Board
Building permit/commencement (BBMP/BDA/CMDA/DTCP), EC if ≥ 20,000 m², Fire NOC provisional, KSPCB/TNPCB CTE where applicable, C&D waste plan (2025 Rules)
Safety officer (250+ workers), safety committee, site safety plan, daily inspections, 7-day scaffold and daily excavation registers
Lifting appliances tested, hoists licensed, electrical by licensed electrician with RCDs, PESO licence for diesel > 2,500 L
Accident notice Form XI (12 h) / state form; fatal forthwith to ICF, police, family

t: Infrastructure – Roads, Bridges, Metro, Tunnels, Water Works
desc: Linear and underground projects (NHAI/state highways, BMRCL/CMRL metro, water supply) with public traffic, utilities and marine interfaces.
hazards: Traffic intrusion, tunnelling atmosphere/collapse, piling rig overturn, blasting flyrock/vibration, working over water, bitumen burns, utility strikes
statutory: BOCW/OSH Code registration per state; contractor licence; client SHE manuals (NHAI, BMRCL, CMRL)
Traffic police permissions, IRC:SP:55 signage; PESO explosives licences and DM intimation for blasting; port/coast guard for marine; CRZ
EC for highways/metro as per EIA notification; tree-cutting permissions; HMP consents
Compressed-air work medical surveillance; DGMS where quarries supply aggregates

t: General Engineering & Manufacturing Factory (Machining, Fabrication, Assembly)
desc: Registered factories with machines, cranes, welding, paint shops, compressed air and warehouses — Peenya, Hosur, Oragadam, Sriperumbudur, Coimbatore clusters.
hazards: Machine entanglement, EOT crane/forklift incidents, welding fire/fumes, paint-shop flammables/isocyanates, noise, electrical, manual handling
statutory: OSH Code registration (legacy Factories licence), occupier/manager notice, Safety Officer (500+; hazardous 250+), Safety Committee, welfare (canteen 100+, crèche 50+), medical examinations for dangerous operations
Lifting machines/tackles 12-monthly test; pressure vessels Rule 61; electrical CEIG inspection; Fire NOC; CTE/CTO; HW authorisation; Form V; HW Form 4; EPR for e-waste/batteries/used oil
Karnataka Safety Audit Rules 2024 where applicable; working-hours/OT/women night-work conditions

t: Foundry & Metal Casting / Forging / Heat Treatment
desc: Ferrous and non-ferrous foundries (Coimbatore, Belagavi, Shimoga, Chennai), forges and heat-treatment shops.
hazards: Molten-metal explosions and burns, furnace failures, ladle/crane failures, silica dust, CO, metal fumes, heat stress, noise, HAV
statutory: Dangerous-operations schedules (foundry, lead, chrome, sand-blasting): medical exams, PPE, LEV; Sch. II PELs; silicosis notifiable
Lifting gear (ladles) tested; furnaces earthed/CEIG; KSPCB/TNPCB cupola & furnace emission norms; HW authorisation (slag, spent sand classification)
Fire NOC; heat-stress plan; safety committee/officer thresholds; Karnataka safety audit where applicable

t: Chemical / Pharma / Petrochemical Process Plant (incl. MAH units)
desc: Process plants handling hazardous chemicals at or above MSIHC thresholds, bulk-drug units, solvent recovery, chlor-alkali, fertilizer, refineries (Manali, Cuddalore, Mangaluru, Dharwad clusters).
hazards: Loss of containment, fire/explosion, toxic release, runaway reactions, confined-space, static, dust, tank-farm incidents
statutory: MSIHC: site notification, safety report (3-yr), annual safety audit, on-site plan (6-monthly rehearsal), off-site plan/District Crisis Group drill, MSDS; PLI insurance; Chemical Accidents Rules
OSH Code Ch. XII hazardous processes; Safety Officer (250+), Safety Committee, OHC/medical officer; Karnataka Safety Audit Rules 2024
PESO licences (petroleum, cylinders, SMPV), CEIG, Boilers Act, Fire NOC, CTE/CTO with OCEMS, HW authorisation, EIA/EC; CCTS if chlor-alkali/refinery/petrochemical/fertilizer; BRSR if listed

t: Petroleum Depot / Terminal / Fuel Station & Site Fuel Storage
desc: Oil-marketing depots, LPG bottling, retail outlets, aviation fuel farms, and construction-site diesel installations.
hazards: Tank/UST leaks, tanker loading fires, static, vapour clouds, overfill, LPG BLEVE, hot work in dyke
statutory: Petroleum Rules 2002 licences & safety distances; Gas Cylinders/SMPV Rules; OISD standards (105, 116, 117, 118, 129, 244); Fire NOC; CPCB vapour recovery; SPCB consent; HW (tank bottoms)
MSIHC where thresholds exceeded; PLI; PNGRB for pipelines/CGD; static-electricity control per IS 7689 / NFPA 77; Boilers Act for any boilers

t: Power & Electrical – Substations, Solar/Wind Farms, Battery Storage, EV Infrastructure
desc: Captive/utility substations, rooftop and ground-mount solar (KREDL/TEDA), BESS, DG plants, EV charging hubs.
hazards: Electrocution, arc flash, DC arcs, battery fires/hydrogen, falls from roofs/towers, transformer oil fires, SF6
statutory: Electricity Act & CEA Safety Regulations 2023: CEIG approval before energising, periodic inspection, competent persons, accident notice 48 h
Fire NOC, Battery Waste Rules 2022, BIS QCO for modules/inverters, MNRE/BEE standards; BOCW/OSH Code for construction crews; AAI NOC for tall structures
CCTS/BRSR relevance for RE procurement and Scope 2

desc: Distribution centres, e-commerce fulfilment, cold chains (ammonia refrigeration), container yards (Whitefield, Hoskote, Oragadam, Chennai port corridor).
hazards: Forklift/pedestrian collisions, racking collapse, falls from mezzanines/docks, fire in high-piled storage, ammonia leaks, battery charging, manual handling
statutory: Shops & Establishments/OSH Code registration; Fire NOC for storage occupancy (NBC Part 4); forklift operator authorisation & RTO; PESO for LPG forklifts; MSIHC for ammonia above threshold
Welfare, working hours, women night work (Karnataka S&E 2026 amendment); e-waste/battery EPR handling

t: Heavy Industry – Cement, Steel, Aluminium, Pulp & Paper, Textiles (CCTS / CBAM sectors)
desc: Energy-intensive plants that are designated consumers under the EC Act and obligated entities under CCTS, often exporting into EU CBAM scope.
hazards: Hot processes, kilns/furnaces, molten metal, combustible dust (coal, bagasse, cotton), conveyors, mobile plant, confined spaces (silos, digesters), chemicals (chlorine in pulp, acids), noise
statutory: EC Act designated consumer: energy manager, mandatory energy audit, PAT/CCTS GEI targets (cement, aluminium, pulp & paper, chlor-alkali from Oct 2025; refineries, petrochemicals, textiles from Jan 2026; iron & steel draft June 2026), verified report 31 Jul, CCC trading
CBAM data for EU customers (steel, aluminium, cement, fertiliser); BRSR/BRSR Core if listed
Factories/OSH Code, MSIHC where applicable, Mines Act for captive mines (DGMS), boilers, CEIG, SPCB OCEMS, HW/fly-ash rules, Fire NOC

desc: Quarries and crushers supplying construction, captive limestone/iron-ore mines.
hazards: Blasting, bench/dump failure, HEMM collisions, silica dust, crusher entanglement, flooding
statutory: Mines Act/OSH Code mines provisions; DGMS regulations, manager/blaster certification, DGMS accident notices; Explosives Rules; state minor-mineral concession rules; EC/consents; CCTS indirectly (cement captive mines)

desc: Municipal and industrial treatment plants (BWSSB, CMWSSB, CETPs) with chlorine, H2S, confined spaces and electrical hazards.
hazards: Chlorine/H2S release, confined-space sumps, drowning, biological exposure, electrical in wet areas, chemical dosing
statutory: MSIHC for chlorine (tonners); Gas Cylinders Rules; Water Act consents/discharge norms; Factories/OSH Code; CEA; Bio-medical/HW for sludge; Public Health Acts

desc: The head-office function that consolidates site data into BRSR, CCTS, CBAM, energy returns and customer ESG questionnaires.
hazards: Misstatement/greenwashing, missed statutory deadlines, unverifiable OSH KPIs, data inconsistencies across filings
statutory: SEBI BRSR/BRSR Core assurance (all top 1,000 by FY2026-27; value chain ≥ 2%); EC Act returns/audits; CCTS verified reports; EPR registrations/returns; CBAM customer data; Form V; HW Form 4; OSH Code annual return as OSH data source
